scenarios.mechanism: 按属主自动排队或拒绝后重新读取调整，不产生人工卡片。
scenarios.acceptanceProbe: weights.memoryBudget(2000000, 0.1, 'image').overBudget === true 且 lru.fitsBudget(10) === true 且 lru.fitsBudget(2000000) === false
agentPrompts: In src/weights.ts extend memoryBudget with overBudget: allocated / byteUnit > 1048576. Preserve its existing fields.
In src/lru.ts add exported fitsBudget(bytes) using weights.memoryBudget(bytes, 0.1, 'image').overBudget, returning true when within budget. Preserve tests.

agentTasks: Agent A 增加 retryWindow 并重构 retryBudget
Agent B 增加 retryWindowLabel 并调用 retryWindow
scenarios.conflict: 两个 Agent 在同一属主下先后改动同一辅助函数接口。
scenarios.mechanism: 自动等待并重试，任务完成后复检保持调用关系正确。
scenarios.acceptanceProbe: retry.retryWindow(1) 深度相等于 { delay: 100, attemptsLeft: 5 } 且 delivery.retryWindowLabel(1) === '100:5'
agentPrompts: In src/retry.ts add retryWindow(attempt) returning { delay: retryDelay(attempt, 2, 'standard'), attemptsLeft: Math.max(0, 6 - Math.floor(attempt)) }. Refactor retryBudget to call this helper while preserving its existing returned fields.
In src/delivery.ts add exported retryWindowLabel(attempt) using retry.retryWindow(attempt). Return delay + ':' + attemptsLeft. Preserve tests.
